note: Mechanical flags only. Nothing was removed, rewritten, ranked or summarized; whether a flag matters is the reader's call.
method: Word overlap (Jaccard) on lowercased, stemmed words minus stopwords; sibling pairs ignore their parent's words. Candidate pairs must share min_shared_tokens words that each appear in at most common_token_share of reasons. cross_branch lists pairs under different level-1 reasons scoring between cross_branch_similarity and similarity, as leads for convergence. Catches copies, close rewordings and word variants; misses paraphrases in different words.
